news.headline: Reuters：美國證管會調查輝達會計處理
news.plain: Reuters 引述知情人士，美國證管會（SEC，類似台灣的金管會）執法人員正在檢查輝達可能的會計問題，消息傳出後輝達上週五單日跌約 13～14%。目前還不知道是哪些項目、會不會影響過去的財報數字。
news.plain_en: Reuters, citing people briefed on the matter, says SEC enforcement staff are examining possible accounting issues at NVIDIA; the stock fell about 13–14% on Friday. It is not yet clear which items are involved or whether past results could be affected.
news.why_me: 你持有 81 股，約占總資產 17.69%，還在 20% 上限以內，不需要賣；但也不要加碼，等調查結果更清楚。請保留買進紀錄。
news.why_me_en: You hold 81 shares, about 17.69% of total assets, still under the 20% cap, so no need to sell; don’t add until the probe is clearer. Keep your purchase records.

news.headline: 國安基金護盤，台股反彈 778 點
news.headline_en: Stabilization fund steps in; TAIEX rebounds 778 points
news.plain: 台股今天盤中上下震盪 1,665 點，最後收漲 778 點、2.16%，收 36,811 點；台積電收 2,030 元，櫃買指數漲 2.88%。行政院長表示願意檢討擴大國安基金規模。
news.plain_en: TAIEX swung 1,665 points intraday before closing up 778 points (2.16%) at 36,811; TSMC closed at NT$2,030 and the OTC index rose 2.88%. The premier said the government is open to enlarging the stabilization fund.
news.why_me: 你的台積電、0050、00881 今天都跟著反彈。護盤能減緩下跌，但外資連 6 天賣超，不代表已經止跌；照計畫暫不增加台灣科技股。
news.why_me_en: Your TSMC, 0050 and 00881 all bounced today. Government buying can slow the fall, but foreign investors sold for a 6th straight day, so it doesn’t mean the bottom is in; per plan, don’t add Taiwan tech for now.

news.headline: 美股上週五重挫，那斯達克今年漲幅歸零
news.headline_en: US stocks slump Friday; Nasdaq turns negative for the year
news.plain: 標普 500 上週五跌 3.7%，科技股賣壓擴大，那斯達克全年轉為下跌。市場擔心 AI 的龐大投資回收不了。
news.plain_en: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% Friday as the tech sell-off widened, and the Nasdaq turned negative for the year. Investors worry huge AI spending won’t pay off.
news.why_me: 標普 500 收 6,910 點，離動用預備金的 5,874 點還很遠；你一半以上是現金，不需要急著動作。
news.why_me_en: The S&P 500 closed at 6,910, far above the 5,874 level for using reserve cash; with over half your assets in cash, no need to rush.
news.source: 美聯社 AP（Chattanooga Times Free Press 轉載）
